title: Hom descent on a finite family of pairwise pullbacks
statement: Use the canonical adjoints from [def-weil-pbc-condensed-local-coefficient-adjoints]. Let f:X→T, ell prime, M an f*Omega-module, E finite, I a finite index type and g_i:Y_i→X any family whose pairwise pullbacks are qcqs. Let N_i be globally finitely presented g_i*f*E-modules with specified Omega-extension isomorphisms to g_i*M. There is one finite F≥E and, on every Y_i×X Y_j, forward and reverse underlying abelian-sheaf maps between the pulled F-extensions of N_i and N_j. The forward map commutes with the canonical adjoints and the specified upperStarCompIso; the reverse map commutes with those adjoints and the inverse comparison. No cover, affine, pro-etale, or quasi-separatedness assumption on X is needed. No monicity, scalar-adjoint invertibility, inverse identities or gluing conclusion is asserted.

proof.text: Keep the actual pulled coefficient rings. Scalar-extension coequalizers commute with their colimit: apply the coequalizer-colimit lemma to the ring colimit transported by upperStar f and upperStar g. This gives rawScalarCocone_isColimit.

Extend the cocone point by the given Omega-extension isomorphism and mapModComapIso. Its legs are exactly the specified finiteCoefficientLocalAdjoint, by the scalar unit identities. Pull back the cocone to an overlap and restrict along the monoidal E-ring comparison, which is an equivalence. The source is finitely presented by fp_pullback.

Index all ordered pairs and both directions by I times I times Bool. Apply condensed_fp_hom_stage to each pulled source and the constructed cocone, and take one common upper object in the filtered coefficient category. This also handles the empty family.

Apply the fixed-field overlap factor transposition to each factor. The two Boolean cases provide the forward and reverse maps. The comparison for the reversed square is the inverse of the original comparison. The helper uses the component representation overlapComparison. Its proved equality to the unchanged upstream upperStarCompIso transports both final equations to the exact original statement.

theorem exists_finiteCoefficient_family_hom_factorizations
    (T X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ T) (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (padicAlgClRingObj T ℓ)))
    (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields ℓ (PadicAlgCl ℓ))
    (I : Type u) [Finite I] (Y : I → Scheme.{u}) (g : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ X)
    [∀ (i j : I), CompactSpace (pullback (g i) (g j) : Scheme.{u})]
    [∀ (i j : I), QuasiSeparatedSpace (pullback (g i) (g j) : Scheme.{u})]
    (N : ∀ i, Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (Y i)) Ab.{u + 1})
      ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (g i)).obj
        ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (padicSubfieldRingObj T ℓ E))))
    (hN : ∀ i, Mod.IsFinitelyPresented ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (g i)).obj
      ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (padicSubfieldRingObj T ℓ E))) (N i))
    (e : ∀ i, (Mod.extendScalars ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (g i)).map
      ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).map (padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl T ℓ E)))).obj (N i) ≅
      ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (g i)).mapMod
        ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (padicAlgClRingObj T ℓ))).obj M) :
    ∃ (F : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields ℓ (PadicAlgCl ℓ)) (hEF : E ≤ F),
      let L := fun i ↦ finiteCoefficientLocalModel T X f ℓ E (Y i) (g i) (N i) F hEF
      let q := fun i ↦ finiteCoefficientLocalAdjoint T X f ℓ E (Y i) (g i) (N i) M
        (e i).hom F hEF
      let B := ((Mod.comap ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).map
        (padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl T ℓ F))).obj M).X
      ∀ i j, ∃ (s : (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.fst (g i) (g j))).obj (L i).X ⟶
          (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.snd (g i) (g j))).obj (L j).X)
        (t : (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.snd (g i) (g j))).obj (L j).X ⟶
          (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.fst (g i) (g j))).obj (L i).X),
        (s ≫ (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.snd (g i) (g j))).map (q j).hom =
          (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.fst (g i) (g j))).map (q i).hom ≫
            (upperStarCompIso Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.condition (f := g i) (g := g j))).hom.app
              B) ∧
        (t ≫ (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.fst (g i) (g j))).map (q i).hom =
          (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.snd (g i) (g j))).map (q j).hom ≫
            (upperStarCompIso Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.condition (f := g i) (g := g j))).inv.app
              B)
